cells.gaps: Stratégie nationale du numérique 2021-2025 ended in 2025 and no successor strategy is on record: TUN-001 gives only a 'broader national vision for 2026-2030', not a named strategy in preparation. Also holds rows for the predecessor Plan national stratégique Tunisie Digitale 2020 (extended to 2025), whose body row (TUN-008) is not carried to this instrument; no text, plan or governance rows for the 2021-2025 strategy.
cells.note: Strategy 2021-2025 (Stratégie nationale du numérique) is adopted but its period ended before 2026 with no successor on record, so the cell is unplaced and lapsed.
